x-m-h1-07.title: Umugqa uzothinta isiyingi? Uma ulwazi luvezwa ucezu o-1 ngesikhathi
x-m-h1-07.goal: Bikezela indawo yomugqa nesiyingi kuye ngenani lokungaguquki k, lungisa isinqumo sakho ngolwazi olusha, bese unciphisa ibanga lika-k lapho bethintana khona.
x-m-h1-07.material: Kunesiyingi x²+y²=25 (inkabe ku-origin, ibanga lomjikelezo 5) nomugqa y=x+k. Shintsha inani lika-k bese ubheka inani lamaphoyinti lapho umugqa nesiyingi kuhlangana khona.
x-m-h1-07.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwenani lezixazululo uma uxazulula umugqa nesiyingi ndawonye nenani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.prompt: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho inani lika-k livezwa, bikezela bese ukhetha inani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana noma inani lokuthinta.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ungahlola inani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana ngezixazululo zesibalo osithola ngokuxazulula izibalo zomugqa nesiyingi ndawonye.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala nendlela yokuqhathanisa ibanga elisuka ku-origin liye emugqeni nosayizi webanga lomjikelezo.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Uma k=1, umugqa ungu-y=x+1. (I-y-intercept engu-1 incane kunebanga lomjikelezo elingu-5.)
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.after: x²+(x+1)²=25 yenziwa lula ibe ngu-x²+x−12=0, ngakho x=−4, 3, futhi amaphoyinti okuhlangana angu-(−4, −3), (3, 4), angu-2 sebonke. Umugqa odlula ephoyintini ngaphakathi kwesiyingi (eduze ne-origin) njalo uhlangana nesiyingi emaphoyintini amabili.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lokhu kubonisa umqondo wokuthi umugqa odlula ngaphakathi kwesiyingi uhlangana nesiyingi kabili.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lesi yisinqumo sokuthi umugqa ungaphandle kwesiyingi. Cabanga ukuthi i-origin ikude kangakanani nomugqa.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lesi yisinqumo sokuthi umugqa uyathinta. Cabanga ngeqiniso lokuthi umugqa udlula eduze nephoyinti elingaphakathi kwesiyingi, i-origin.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.info: U-k wakhuphulwa waba ngu-7. Umugqa u-y=x+7 uhlangana ne-y-axis ku-(0, 7), futhi u-7 mkhulu kunebanga lomjikelezo elingu-5.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.after: x²+(x+7)²=25 yenziwa lula ibe ngu-x²+7x+12=0, ngakho x=−3, −4, futhi amaphoyinti okuhlangana angu-(−3, 4), (−4, 3), angu-2 sebonke. Ibanga elisuka ku-origin liye emugqeni x−y+7=0 lingu-7/√2 (7 phezu kwempande yesikwele ka-2) ≈ 4.95, elincane kunebanga lomjikelezo elingu-5. Noma i-y-intercept inkulu kuno-5, umugqa uthambekile, ngakho ufinyelela esiyingini.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uma wahlulela nge-y-intercept kuphela, ungaphutha umthelela owenziwa umthambeka womugqa. Cabangela ibanga elisuka ku-origin liye emugqeni.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukuthi uyathinta kufanele kuhlolwe ngebanga noma nge-discriminant. Ungakubala.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Lokhu kucabanga okubheka hhayi kuphela i-y-intercept kodwa ukuthi umugqa useduze kangakanani nesiyingi. Isinqumo esizindela ukuthi umqondo nokubala kungahluka.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Uma k=7 kwakunamaphoyinti okuhlangana angu-2, futhi uma u-k ekhushulwa abe ngu-8, awekho amaphoyinti okuhlangana.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yiliphi inani le-positive lika-k elenza umugqa uthinte isiyingi?
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Uma uthinta, ibanga |k|/√2 elisuka ku-origin liye emugqeni x−y+k=0 lingu-5, ngakho k=5√2≈7.07. Ukusebenzisa i-discriminant nakho kunikeza, kusuka ku-2x²+2kx+k²−25=0, D/4=50−k²=0, ngakho k²=50. Ku-7.5, D/4=50−56.25<0, ngakho abahlangani.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Qhathanisa nolwazi lokuthi kwakusivele kunamaphoyinti okuhlangana angu-2 ku-k=7.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kuhambisana nolwazi lokuthi inani liphakathi kuka-7 no-8. Kodwa bala ukuthi ibanga k/√2 phakathi kwe-origin nomugqa kulo k likhulu noma lincane kuno-5.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Bheka futhi ulwazi lokuthi k=7. U-6 mncane kuno-7.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Lesi yisinqumo esixhumanisa ucezu lolwazi oluningi futhi sisebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi inani lapho kuthinta khona lilele phakathi kuka-7 no-8.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.e: Kuzwakala kungenzeka, kodwa hlola ukuthi ibanga phakathi kwe-origin nomugqa ku-7.5 likhulu noma lincane kuno-5.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni kwakubonakala ukuthi ku-k=7, lapho i-y-intercept inkulu kunebanga lomjikelezo, ngeke bahlangane, kodwa eqinisweni bahlangana emaphoyintini amabili. Yimuphi ulwazi owenze walungisa isibikezelo sakho? Yikuphi ukuhlola ongakwenza kube umkhuba ukuze umqondo ungakuhehi?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.prompt: Ku-k=7, chaza ukuthi kungani umcabango wokuqala "i-y-intercept inkulu kunebanga lomjikelezo, ngakho abahlangani" wawungalungile, usebenzisa ibanga phakathi kwe-origin nomugqa noma izixhumanisi zamaphoyinti okuhlangana.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Khumbula ukuthi yisiphi isici somugqa osishiye emcabangweni wakho wokuqala.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala isibalo osithola ngokuxazulula umugqa nesiyingi ndawonye ku-k=7, bese uhlola izixazululo.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uxhumanise ukuthi kungani i-y-intercept yodwa ingeneli nokuthi umugqa uthambekile kangakanani?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale phansi amanani owabalile (ibanga noma amaphoyinti okuhlangana) njengezinombolo?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ungachaza nangale ndlela ukuthi kungani bengahlangani uma k=8?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.model.0: Akufanele ngibheke i-y-intercept kuphela. Umugqa uthambekile, futhi ibanga elisuka ku-origin liye emugqeni, 7/√2≈4.95, lincane kunebanga lomjikelezo elingu-5, ngakho bahlangana. Eqinisweni, (−3, 4) no-(−4, 3) amaphoyinti okuhlangana.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.model.1: Uma umugqa uthambekile, ungafinyelela esiyingini noma iphoyinti lapho ihlangana khona ne-y-axis lingaphandle kwesiyingi. Ukuxazulula ndawonye, x²+7x+12=0 kunikeza u-x=−3, −4, ngakho bahlangana emaphoyintini amabili.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.model.2: Ukuxazulula u-y=x+7 no-x²+y²=25 ndawonye kunikeza u-x²+7x+12=0, ngakho x=-3, -4. Ngakho noma i-y-intercept inkulu kuno-5, bahlangana emaphoyintini amabili.

x-m-h1-01.title: Isixazululo sensalela siphutha kuphi?
x-m-h1-01.goal: Thola umugqa onephutha esixazululweni esithola insalela, ulungise, bese uhlola impendulo engalungile ngokuqhathanisa nesimo sokuqala ukuqinisekisa iphutha.
x-m-h1-01.material: Lesi yisixazululo sika-Minjae sokuthola okungaguquki a ukuze insalela ibe ngu-6 uma i-polynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 ihlukaniswa ngo-x+1. (x³ isho x ophindwe ngokwakho kathathu, futhi ax² isho a ephindwe nesikwele sika-x.)
x-m-h1-01.thinking.0: Funda lonke isixazululo bese uthola umugqa onephutha
x-m-h1-01.thinking.1: Lungisa iphutha bese uthola impendulo entsha
x-m-h1-01.thinking.2: Faka impendulo engalungile esimweni ubone ukuphikisana
x-m-h1-01.prereq.0: Uyazi ubudlelwano phakathi kwensalela uma i-polynomial ihlukaniswa ngesibalo se-linear nenani le-polynomial.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala onephutha esixazululweni sika-Minjae.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala kabusha u-x+1 ukuze isihlukanisi sibe nefomu elithi x−(inombolo ethile).
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa leyo nombolo nenani olifake ku-f.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.line.0: Insalela uma f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 ihlukaniswa ngo-x+1 ingu-6.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.line.1: Ngethiyori Yensalela, insalela uma uhlukanisa ngo-x+1 ngu-f(1).
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 uphutha. x+1 ingabhalwa njengo-x−(−1), ngakho insalela ngu-f(−1), hhayi f(1). Imigqa 3 no-4 ilandela nje umugqa 2, ngakho ukubala okungaphakathi kwayo kulungile, kodwa imiphumela yayo iphutha.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umugqa onephutha bese uthola inani lika-a. Bese ubhala nokuthi insalela iyini uma ufaka u-a=2 ka-Minjae ku-f(x) bese uhlukanisa ngo-x+1, ukukhombisa ukuthi kungani impendulo ka-Minjae ayisebenzi.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale inani lika-x elenza u-x+1=0.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faka u-a owutholile ngomugqa olungisiwe no-a=2 ka-Minjae ku-f(x), bese uqhathanisa insalela.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubale u-f(−1) ngqo esixazululweni esilungisiwe?
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubale insalela uma a=2 bese ukhombisa ukuthi ayingu-6?
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungasho yini ukuthi ukuhlola kuyibonisa kanjani iphutha esixazululweni?
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.model.0: x+1=x−(−1), ngakho insalela ngu-f(−1). f(−1)=−1+a−1+2=a, futhi lokhu kungu-6, ngakho a=6. Uma ngifaka u-a=2 ka-Minjae, f(−1)=2, ngakho akungu-6.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.model.1: Uma uhlukanisa ngo-x+1, kufanele ngifake x=−1, ngakho f(−1)=a. Insalela ingu-6, ngakho a=6. Hlola: uma a=2, khona-ke f(−1)=−1+2−1+2=2, ngakho ayihambisani nesimo.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ukuhlola ngenani elilungile (uma a=6, khona-ke f(−1)=6) nakho kuyindlela enhle.

x-m-h1-02.title: Yenza ukungalingani kwe-quadratic okunezixazululo ezingu-3 eziphelele ngqo
x-m-h1-02.goal: Qonda isimo sokuthi ukungalingani kwe-quadratic kube nezixazululo ezingu-3 eziphelele ngqo ngokwezindawo zezimpande ezimbili, bese wenza izibonelo ezihlukile futhi uzihlole.
x-m-h1-02.material: Kukhona ukungalingani kwe-quadratic x²+bx+c<0 (x isikwele kwengeziwe b x kwengeziwe c incane kuno-0). b no-c yizinombolo eziphelele, futhi ufuna ama-x aphelele angu-3 ngqo ukuthi agculise lokhu kungalingani. Biza izimpande ezimbili ngo-α (alpha) no-β (beta), kusukela encane.
x-m-h1-02.thinking.1: Cabanga ukuthi umkhawulo (< nga-≤) ubalulekile kanjani.
x-m-h1-02.prereq.0: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande zesibalo se-quadratic nalapho igrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic ihlangana khona ne-x-axis
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.prompt: Uma kunezixazululo ezingu-3 eziphelele ngqo, yini okufanele ihlale iyiqiniso ngomehluko β−α wezimpande ezimbili?
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukungalingani okunye okunezixazululo 0, 1, 2 nokunye okunezixazululo −1, 0, 1, bese udweba lapho izimpande kufanele zibe khona kwenye.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi izimpande kufanele zibe kuphi ukuze izinombolo eziphelele ngaphandle kwezixazululo eziphelele (isibonelo −1 no-3 uma izixazululo zingu-0, 1, 2) zingabi yizixazululo.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kungase kube yimicabango esekelwe kuphela ezimpandeni eziphelele njengo-(−1, 3). Hlola ukuthi izimpande zingaba yizinombolo ezingeyona eziphelele yini.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.b: Emkhawulweni, < no-≤ kungashintshana. Cabanga ngecala lapho izixazululo zingu-0, 1, 2 futhi izimpande ngu-−1 no-3.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.c: Lo mbono ubeka izixazululo eziphelele ezingu-3 esikhaleni phakathi kwezimpande ezimbili futhi ucabanga ngokungenzeka eziphethweni zombili.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.d: Inani lezixazululo eziphelele nokuthi umehluko wezimpande uyinombolo ephelele yini kufanele kucatshangwe ngokwehlukana. Zama ukungalingani okufana no-x²−3<0.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.explain: Uma izinombolo eziphelele ezilandelanayo n, n+1, n+2 ziyizixazululo, khona-ke α<n no-β>n+2, ngakho β−α>2. Futhi, n−1 no-n+3 akuyona izixazululo, ngakho α≥n−1 no-β≤n+3, okunika β−α≤4. Kungenzeka nalapho izimpande zingeyona izinombolo eziphelele, ngakho umehluko akudingeki ube yinombolo ephelele (izixazululo ze-x²−3<0 ngu-−1, 0, 1).
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.prompt: Khetha izinombolo eziphelele b no-c ukwenza ukungalingani kwe-quadratic okungu-3 okuhlukile x²+bx+c<0, ngakunye kunezixazululo eziphelele ezingu-3 ngqo.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhulise i-quadratic enezimpande eziphelele, (x−p)(x−q)<0, uthole b no-c. Bala ukuthi kunezixazululo eziphelele ezingaki.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi kungenzeka nalapho izimpande zingeyona izinombolo eziphelele. Cabanga ukuthi ungazibala kanjani izinombolo eziphelele phakathi kwezimpande ezimbili kuleso simo.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.fail.c1: b no-c kufanele zibe yizinombolo eziphelele.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Azikho izimpande ezimbili ezingempela ezihlukile (akukho sixazululo, noma isethi yesixazululo ayinalutho).
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.explain: x²−2x−3<0 ngu-(x+1)(x−3)<0, ngakho −1<x<3, futhi izixazululo eziphelele ngu-0, 1, 2. x²−4x<0 inika 0<x<4, ngakho 1, 2, 3. x²−3<0 inika −√3<x<√3, ngakho −1, 0, 1. x²−x−6<0 inezixazululo eziphelele ezingu-4, −1, 0, 1, 2, ngakho ayisebenzi.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha esinye sezibonelo zakho esinezimpande eziphelele nesinye esinezimpande ezingeyona eziphelele, bese uchaza ukuthi indlela yokubala izixazululo eziphelele ifana kanjani futhi ihluka kanjani.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Esibonelweni esinezimpande eziphelele, cabanga ukuthi izimpande ngokwazo zifakiwe ezixazululweni yini.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Esibonelweni esinezimpande ezingeyona eziphelele, khumbula ukuthi uzibale kanjani izixazululo eziphelele.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho ukuthi kungani izimpande ngokwazo zingabalwa njengezixazululo esibonelweni esinezimpande eziphelele?
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi indlela efanayo (ukubala izinombolo eziphelele phakathi kwezimpande ezimbili) isetshenziswa noma izimpande zingeyona izinombolo eziphelele?
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ubale ngalunye ukuhlola ukuthi isibonelo sakho sinezixazululo eziphelele ezingu-3 ngempela?
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma izimpande ziyizinombolo eziphelele (−1 no-3), uphawu lungu-<, ngakho izimpande ngokwazo azizona izixazululo, futhi ngibala kuphela u-0, 1, 2 phakathi kwazo. Uma izimpande zingeyona izinombolo eziphelele (−√3 no-√3), akudingeki ngikhathazeke ngezimpande ngoba azizona izinombolo eziphelele, futhi ngibala izinombolo eziphelele phakathi kwezimpande ezimbili, −1, 0, 1.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ukubala izinombolo eziphelele phakathi kwezimpande ezimbili kuyafana. Umehluko ukuthi uma izimpande ziyizinombolo eziphelele, kufanele ngihlole ngokwehlukana ukuthi izimpande azifakiwe, futhi uma zingeyona izinombolo eziphelele, alukho uhlolo olunjalo oludingekayo.

x-m-h1-03.title: Udinga ukwazi ini ukuze usho ukuthi zombili izimpande zinhle?
x-m-h1-03.goal: Khetha ulwazi oludingekayo ngempela ukuphetha ngokuthi zombili izimpande zesibalo se-quadratic ziyizinombolo ezingempela ezinhle, bese usebenzisa izibonelo eziphikisayo ukukhombisa ukuthi ingxenye yalo kuphela ayanele.
x-m-h1-03.material: Kukhona isibalo se-quadratic x²+bx+c=0 (x isikwele kwengeziwe b x kwengeziwe c lilingana no-0, lapho b no-c bayizinombolo ezingempela). Ufuna ukusho ukuthi zombili izimpande ziyizinombolo ezingempela ezinhle (uma kunempande ephindwe kabili, leyo mpande inhle). Ungatshelwa ulwazi oluthile olungezansi.
x-m-h1-03.thinking.1: Khombisa ukuthi isibonelo esiphikisayo sikhona uma ulwazi lungenele
x-m-h1-03.thinking.2: Xhuma ubudlelwano phakathi kwezimo (isamba, umphumela, izimpande zangempela)
x-m-h1-03.prereq.0: Uyazi ubudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande ezimbili ze-x²+bx+c=0 nama-coefficients b no-c.
x-m-h1-03.prereq.1: Uyawazi umbandela we-quadratic equation ukuthi ibe nezimpande zangempela.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha lonke ulwazi oludingeka ngempela ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi zombili izimpande ziyizinombolo zangempela ezinhle. (Kwanele ukwazi konke okudingekayo; ungakhethi okungadingekile.)
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubhale izimpawu zomphumela nesamba sezimpande ezimbili uma zombili izimpande zinhle.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi, noma uyazi izimpawu zesamba nomphumela, izimpande zingase zingabi zangempela.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.a: Ungabona ukuthi ukuba yinombolo ephelele noma cha akunalo uxhumano oluqondile nezimpawu zezimpande. Isibonelo, x²−3x+1=0 inama-coefficients aphelele kodwa izimpande ezingezona izinombolo eziphelele.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kubonisa umqondo wokuthi kumele uhlole ukuthi izimpande ziyizangempela ngaphambi kokukhuluma ngezimpawu zazo.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kuguqule umbandela wokuthi umphumela wezimpande ezimbili muhle waba ulwazi.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kuguqule umbandela wokuthi isamba sezimpande ezimbili sihle saba ulwazi.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.e: Lokhu kusho ukuthi c akungu-0. Cabanga ukuthi sekuqukethwe kakade kolunye ulwazi yini.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.explain: Uma izimpande ezimbili ziyizangempela (i-discriminant b²−4c≥0), isamba −b sihle, futhi umphumela c muhle, khona zombili izimpande zinhle. Uma umphumela muhle, izimpande ezimbili zinophawu olufanayo, futhi uma isamba sihle, zombili zinhle. Ukuthi b no-c bayizinombolo eziphelele akudingeki, futhi ukuthi x=0 akuyona impande sekuqukethwe kakade ku-c>0.

Lapha u-A uyi-matrix engu-2×2 enomugqa wayo wokuqala (1, 1) nowesibili (0, 1), futhi u-B uyi-matrix engu-2×2 enomugqa wayo wokuqala (p, q) nowesibili (r, s).

x-m-h1-06.s.s1.r.b: Hlola ukuthi ngabe lawo kuphela amacala lapho iyiqiniso yini. Isibonelo, cabanga ngo-A no-A.

x-m-h1-06.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kubonisa ukucabanga kokunweba uhlangothi lwesobunxele ngomthetho we-distributive nokuqhathanisa ukuthi luhluka kuphi kulolo lwesokudla.
